controls.plain: The sun and its glow get stronger the louder the music is.

blender.effect: sun, horizon glow, moon rim

godot.effect: sun glow through the cloud gap

controls.plain: Bass makes things hit harder: the glowing ground net and waterline in Blender, the shake and dust of each footfall in Godot.

blender.effect: ground wireframe brightness, waterline rim

godot.effect: footfall weight: camera shake, dust size

controls.plain: Pulses on every beat: pyramid edges, stars and water glints in Blender, footfalls and dust puffs in Godot.

blender.effect: pyramid edges and capstones, stars, grid, water glints

godot.effect: footfalls, dust puffs, cut points; an internal 90 BPM beat runs while it is quiet

controls.plain: Turns all colours around the colour wheel.

blender.effect: rotates the whole palette

controls.plain: Makes the whole picture brighter or darker.

blender.effect: overall brightness

controls.plain: Flashes the picture to white; higher means a stronger flash.

blender.effect: flash to white

controls.group: Ground, water and things on it
controls.plain: Makes the glowing grid on the ground scroll faster.

blender.effect: island scene only: grid scroll; the planet has no scrolling lines and does not read it

controls.plain: Cuts to camera number N; 0 is the first shot.

planet.name: Plaza View
planet.shows: A wide view from 70 m up, looking up the plaza toward the pyramids and the sun. It stands still.

planet.name: River Skim
planet.shows: A low view 9 m over the nearest river, looking downstream along the water. It stands still.

planet.name: Pyramid Hero
planet.shows: Close and low in front of the pyramids, the main pyramid shot. It stands still.

planet.name: Moon Watch
planet.shows: Low among the hills, tilted up over the pyramids; at night it follows the moon. It stands still.

planet.name: Pole Flyover
planet.shows: Flies a loop around the planet's pole over the hills, looking ahead along its path.

planet.name: Pyramid Orbit
planet.shows: Circles the pyramids above the ground, always looking at them.

planet.name: Planet Orbit
planet.shows: Circles the whole Planet from space, with the Planet and the moon in frame.

planet.name: Flamingo Lake
planet.shows: Low over the water next to the pyramids, looking toward the sun, with the flamingo flock on the lake. It stands still.

planet.name: River Mouth
planet.shows: Looks downstream along a river as it runs into the sea. It stands still.

planet.name: Far Pyramids
planet.shows: A pyramid group far from the valley with the sun behind it. It stands still and follows the sun.

planet.name: Coast Pass
planet.shows: A low pass along a coast, out over the water with the sea on one side, looking toward the land.

planet.name: Flight
planet.shows: The flying camera: /vj/flight carries it from orbit down to the mountains and a hover over the water.

island.name: Plaza View
island.shows: A wide view from 70 m up, looking up the plaza toward the pyramids. It stands still.

island.name: Valley Low
island.shows: A very wide lens 14 m up, looking toward the pyramids from 550 m before them. It stands still.

island.name: Pyramid Hero
island.shows: Close and low beside the pyramids, looking at the main pyramid. It stands still.

island.name: Moon Watch
island.shows: Low to the ground, tilted up into the sky over the pyramids' valley. It stands still.

island.name: Flyover
island.shows: Flies a loop on a path, looking ahead along it.

island.name: Pyramid Orbit
island.shows: Circles the pyramids on a path, always looking at them.

island.name: Wide Orbit
island.shows: Circles on a wide path, looking at a point just north of the pyramids.

godot.name: Scale Wide
godot.shows: A telephoto view from behind the Wanderer that shows the Colossus towering over him; used on the Approach and at the start of the Fall.

godot.name: Low Hero
godot.shows: A low camera beside the Wanderer on the plain, looking up at the Colossus; used on the Approach and now and then on the Climb.

godot.name: Over Shoulder
godot.shows: Looks from the Colossus's surface past the Wanderer up the Grab Path; used on the Climb.

godot.name: Close Grip
godot.shows: Close on the Wanderer's hands at a Grab Point; used on the Climb, cut to at every Shake, and on the Fall.

godot.name: Aerial
godot.shows: Circles the Colossus from above; cut to at a drop.

blender.effect: cut to `CAM_N`; in the planet scene `CAM_11` is the Flight shot; N above the last camera of the scene takes the last

godot.effect: pin the director's Nth shot (0-based); N above the last shot takes the last; held only while `/vj/cam_auto` is 0

controls.plain: 1 lets the scene's director cut between shots by itself, 0 holds the shot that `/vj/cam` picks.

godot.effect: 1: the director cuts by itself; 0: it holds the shot `/vj/cam` picks

controls.plain: Makes the camera drift and fly faster or slower.

blender.effect: camera drift and flyover speed

controls.plain: Lifts the sun up the sky and makes it bigger; 0 sinks it below the horizon.

blender.effect: sun elevation, and size (largest at peak day): 0 sets it below the horizon (night lighting)

controls.plain: Makes the moon bigger or smaller.

blender.effect: moon size. The Moon is not faded: it rises from below the sea as the sun goes down (`/vj/sun`, `/vj/night`) and sets again by day

controls.plain: Changes the shape of the moon from new through half to full.

blender.effect: lunar phase: 1 full, 0.5 half, 0 new (crater shadows along the terminator). Planet scene (star system): where the moon sits on its orbit, 0 next to the sun, 1 opposite it, lit by the real sun

controls.group: Ground, water and things on it
controls.plain: Makes the pyramids rise out of the ground.

blender.effect: pyramids rise from the ground

controls.group: Ground, water and things on it
controls.plain: Shows the real triangle edges of the ground as a glowing net at night; by day there is none.

blender.effect: planet: strength of the real edges of the drawn ground mesh (its triangles, never a lattice), fading in from sunset (/vj/night 0.25 to 0.5), full at night, none by day, pulsed by bass and beat; island: ground wireframe by day (the real low-poly mesh edges; the projected grid only remains on the night ground)

controls.plain: Fades the stars in or out.

blender.effect: stars

controls.group: Ground, water and things on it
controls.plain: Turns the reflections on the water up or down.

blender.effect: water reflection

controls.plain: Turns day into night: 0 is day, a quarter is sunset, half is twilight, 1 is night.

blender.effect: time of day: 0 day; 0.25 sunset; 0.5 twilight (blue hour, afterglow, land in silhouette, first stars); 1 night: black land (planet: with the real mesh edges at /vj/grid; island: its glowing low-poly wireframe), deep space sky with Milky Way, bright stars and a volumetric 3D nebula 2-5 km up. Fog darkens toward night. Flamingos take off above 0.18 and return below 0.08. Planet scene (star system): the sun's height for the camera on air, 0 +20°, 0.5 half set on the horizon, 1 -18°; the sky turns to fit, and moving it back runs time backwards

controls.plain: Fades in the coloured cloud in the night sky.

blender.effect: night nebula strength

controls.plain: A shock wave runs over the land once; in Godot the giant shakes while the Wanderer is on it.

blender.effect: rising edge above 0.5: shockwave from the next pyramid, a rolling ground wave (300 m/s, 170 m wavelength, up to 16 m heave) about 3.6 km out in 12 s; the sea heaves harder with chop and foam, pyramids lift and tilt, the grid warps, land and cameras shake. Up to four waves run at once. The trigger value sets the strength (0.5 to 1.5). Fires by itself every 16 s while idle

godot.effect: shake while the Wanderer is on the Colossus; 1.4 and above marks a drop for the next bar

controls.plain: A shooting star crosses the sky.

blender.effect: rising edge above 0.5: a shooting star (up to three at once), brightest at night. Without the trigger only rarely, every 1-3 min at night while idle

controls.group: Ground, water and things on it
controls.plain: Makes the flock of flamingos bigger; 0 hides it.

blender.effect: flamingo flock size; 0 hides them

controls.plain: More fog near the ground; at 1 it is dense autumn fog.

blender.effect: fog bank density, about linear up to 0.6, then it climbs steeply to dense autumn fog at 1, where the ground barely shows. A bank of drifting 3D clouds that fills the valleys and hides what lies behind it, ray-marched per pixel on land, water and pyramids; sky, sun and moon never get it, their reflections in the water do

controls.plain: Makes the fog bank taller or lower.

blender.effect: top of the fog bank (soft over its upper half), 60 m at most so it always stays near the ground

controls.plain: Makes the fog glow by itself.

blender.effect: self-glow

controls.plain: Tints the fog pink, violet or cyan.

blender.effect: colour: pink, violet, cyan, back to pink

controls.plain: Makes the fog patchier.

blender.effect: patchiness

controls.plain: Makes the fog clouds bigger or smaller.

blender.effect: cloud size

controls.plain: Makes the wind push the fog along faster.

blender.effect: wind drift

controls.plain: Makes the fog pump with the beat.

blender.effect: beat pumping

controls.plain: Adds or removes the soft haze toward the horizon.

blender.effect: distance haze toward the horizon; 0 with `/vj/fog` 0 gives a fog-free view

controls.plain: Lines the moon up with the sun and the planet for an eclipse.

blender.effect: planet scene (star system): turns the moon's tilted orbit into line with the sun, a lunar eclipse in the planet's shadow at full moon, a solar eclipse at new moon

controls.plain: Makes the stars drift across the sky.

blender.effect: planet scene (star system): drift of the stars against the sun

controls.plain: Steers the flying camera: 0 high orbit, then a landing approach, a skim over the mountains, and at 1 a hover over the water.

blender.effect: planet scene, Flight camera ([plan](../docs/research/synthwave-flight.md)): 0 orbit framing the star system, 0.33 landing approach, 0.66 skim over the mountains, 1 hover over water. Damped: a jump flies, about a minute from end to end

controls.plain: Gives the flying camera a burst of speed with a wider view.

blender.effect: planet scene, Flight camera: the accelerator while skimming or hovering, a surge forward with a wider view

controls.plain: Makes a camera change fly smoothly to the new shot; 0 cuts at once.

blender.effect: planet scene: duration scale of shot changes, which fly from the current view to the new shot; 0 cuts

controls.plain: Makes the camera move harder, from a slow wide glide to faster, tighter moves.

blender.effect: planet scene: how hard every camera moves. Eased (up over 1.5 s, down over 4 s). Low: a slow, wide floating glide; high: faster, pushed in, tighter lens, bigger pulse accents. Every shot keeps moving even at 0

controls.plain: A quick surge of speed with a wide-angle kick on the camera.

blender.effect: planet scene: rising edge above 0.5: a surge of speed with a wide-angle kick (lens to 0.7x, back over 2 s), a swoop along the path on moving shots
